events.details: Definitely Mightbe (A Tribute to Oasis) About Definitely Mightbe (A Tribute to Oasis) A rousing celebration of Britpop’s defining era, Definitely Mightbe (A Tribute to Oasis) delivers a faithful, high-energy recreation of the anthems that shaped a generation. events.details: About Oxford Symphony Orchestra: Prokofiev and Bruckner Prokofiev – Piano Concerto no 3Bruckner – Symphony no 4 Enoch Wong pianoRobert Max conductor Prokofiev’s lush and fiery popular third piano concerto is full of crackling energy and playfulness. Our soloist is Enoch Wong, an outstanding young pianist noted for his technical brilliance and poetic conviction. Bruckner’s ‘Romantic’ symphony captures the magnificence of the medieval natural world and of the spirit of knights hunting, but it also speaks of the nature of human existence in ways that are no less relevant to us today. events.name: Wolvercote Community Market
events.details: Wolvercote Community Market About Wolvercote Community Market Established in 2002, Wolvercote Community Market is the longest running Farmers’ Market in Oxford, and one of three in the North Oxford area. The market aims to provide the community with locally-produced great tasting food. The Sunday market serves the community and visitors by providing fresh, affordable and ethically sourced food as well as a place to meet, eat and socialise with friends and neighbours. It also provides a free marketplace for local producers and crafts people. Regular stallholders bring fresh fruit and veg,…

events.details: South Oxford Farmers and Community Market About the South Oxford Farmers and Community Market The South Oxford Farmers and Community Market is a weekly market selling local, seasonal food and non-food goods. ‘Local’ means produced within a 30-mile radius of Oxford and ‘produced’ means containing a significant quantity of local ingredients and labour although locality rules do not necessarily apply to ethical enterprises such as Fairtrade or similar organisations.
